hero.headline: Trusted by Ahmedabad's Jewellers for Over 25 Years
hero.subheadline: Founded in 1998 in the heart of Zaveri Bazaar, Ahmedabad Gold Process has grown from a single trading desk to Gujarat's most respected bullion house.

body.text: Ahmedabad Gold Process was founded in 1998 by Shri Kantilal Shah, a third-generation gold trader from Zaveri Bazaar. What began as a small bullion trading desk serving local jewellers has grown into one of Gujarat's most trusted names in gold trading, purity testing, and investment advisory.

Over the past 25 years, we have served more than 500 jewellers, retailers, and institutional clients across Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, and Rajkot. Our reputation is built on three pillars: transparent pricing at live MCX/IBJA rates, certified purity testing, and relationships that span generations.
Today, Ahmedabad Gold Process operates a state-of-the-art trading floor, an in-house XRF and fire assay laboratory, and a secure insured vault — all under one roof at our Zaveri Bazaar headquarters.

credentials.heading: Certifications & Credentials
credentials.subheading: Every transaction is backed by regulatory compliance and certified quality standards.

items.title: BIS Hallmarking
items.description: All gold bars and coins supplied by us carry BIS hallmarks, guaranteeing purity as per Indian standards.

items.title: SEBI Registered
items.description: Registered with SEBI as an investment advisor for gold-related financial products and schemes.

items.title: ISO 9001:2015
items.description: ISO certified for quality management systems across our trading, testing, and storage operations.

items.title: Bullion Exchange Member
items.description: Active member of the India Bullion and Jewellers Association and recognised bullion exchange participant, adhering to industry best practices.

items.title: GST Compliant
items.description: Fully GST registered with transparent invoicing on every transaction — no hidden charges.

items.title: Insured Vault
items.description: Our vault storage is fully insured with a leading Indian insurer, protecting client gold at all times.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Every price is pegged to live MCX/IBJA rates. No markups, no surprises — just honest trading.

items.title: Precision
items.description: Our laboratory delivers purity results accurate to 0.01% — because in gold, every decimal matters.

items.title: Trust
items.description: Over 500 jewellers have traded with us for more than a decade. That loyalty is our greatest credential.

items.title: Speed
items.description: Same-day settlement for registered clients. Instant buy/sell valuations. No waiting, no delays.

cta.headline: Partner With Us
cta.subheadline: Whether you are a jeweller sourcing bulk gold or an investor building a portfolio, we are here to help.
